text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, phew, goal! Even if it's slow, I 
hope I can run a little bit faster, step 
by step~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So, my dear Trainer, how was my time~?
choice_data_list: It hasn't shrunk at all, huh...
It hasn't shrunk at all, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I see~. I still have a long way to go, 
don't I~.

Mejiro Bright was practicing seriously in 
her own way. Even so, shaving off seconds 
has been a slow and sluggish process...

"Did I make the wrong call with our 
strategy after all? Instead of aiming big 
for a GⅠ right away, should I have just 
kept entering her in target races one by 
one?"
As if to stoke those anxieties—

Ohohoho! Briiiight! Yet another complete 
victory for meee!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, you are so fast~, Pearl-sama...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm the fastest in the 
world! Which means I'm the first, the 
fastest!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Put some more effort into it! Otherwise 
you're no good as a training partner. Come 
on! Come on, girl!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Even if you tell me to "c'mon"...

This Umamusume is Seeking the Pearl. A 
classmate who calls herself the world's 
greatest treasure, she's a truly worldly 
Umamusume.

She was cocky, but possessed the speed to 
back it up, and Mejiro Bright could never 
catch up to her at all...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"We debuted in the same class—the same 
generation, right? Then—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't you want to fight me for the world? 
Well, what do you say, Bright?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Indeed~. I do hope to do so eventually~.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"S-O-O-N-E-R or later! If I wait around 
like that, I'll grow old and turn into a 
mermaid!"

Even with the provocation, nothing really 
changed, and no glimmer of hope was in 
sight...
One morning. At the park—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-sama, good day~. Look~, please 
take a look at this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That little bird perched under the tree 
over there. Can you see it~?
choice_data_list: I can see it... Stay still.
I can see it... Keep still, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. Actually, that girl has a minor 
injury. That is why she is behaving so 
quietly like that~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What a good girl you are~. You must have 
been so worried. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"After holding out for so long, she'll 
surely... Surely, it'll happen soon...!"
(Chirp, chirp chirp!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, it's completely healed already~. 
What a relief~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, when the time comes, they can take 
flight. Little birds, and also..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. Though the end of 
the year is already pressing close upon 
us~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there is something I wish to show 
you. Come, let us go together~.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Gah!? Aaaaaah!? UNBELIEVABLEEEEE!!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* You've really stepped up your 
game, Bright. I thought I'd win with no 
problem like usual, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"To close the gap this much on the final 
straight alone... What was that just 
now...?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu~, that was so close, wasn't it~? 
Perhaps the distance was just a bit too 
short~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If only I had a little more~. And if 
Trainer could train me again from here on 
out~.

I witnessed something unbelievable. To 
push the already top-tier Seeking the 
Pearl this far into a corner...

I tried to deduce what had happened. And 
then, an idea struck me—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, I figured it was about time you 
wouldn't have to worry about it anymore~.

Examining Mejiro Bright's leg in the 
nurse's office, sure enough, there is a 
faint trace of growth on her shin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The pain... had been there all along. Even 
if it was only mild.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As long as this continues, I figured I 
just have to endure it~.
choice_data_list:
So that's why you didn't push yourself too 
hard...
So that's why you didn't overdo it, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. I thought I should wait patiently so 
as not to cause you any worry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"These symptoms are common in the Junior 
Class. Even the Mejiro family doctor said, 
'All we can do is wait'~."

Mejiro Bright always went at her own pace. 
But behind that easygoing tempo...

"There was a good reason to do so. This 
time, as well..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No, no~, Trainer. I am the one who should 
apologize~. I was being a naughty girl by 
keeping secrets from you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I had a slow start, but if I push hard 
from here, I'll make it in time, right? 
The GⅠ Hopeful Stakes♪

Having rested her wings, her wounds have 
healed... and just as the clouds part, the 
path ahead opens up all at once.

The day Mejiro Bright would spread her 
wings and soar into the open sky was fast 
approaching.
